subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Instagram and Teen Mental Health
description: One-minute skill: Instagram and Teen Mental Health.

hook.text: Facebook's own researchers found that Instagram makes body image issues worse for one in three teenage girls.

buildup.text: Internal documents showed that teens reported feeling more anxious, depressed, and insecure after using Instagram.

discovery.text: The research was hidden until whistleblower Frances Haugen leaked it to the Wall Street Journal in 2021.

twist.text: Despite knowing the harm, Facebook planned to launch Instagram Kids for children under 13.

climax.text: A company knew its product harmed children, hid the evidence, and planned to expand to younger users.

punchline.text: They knew the harm. They hid the research.

quiz.question: What did Facebook's internal research reveal about Instagram's effect on teens?
options: Instagram worsened body image issues for one in three teenage girls
Instagram had no measurable effect on mental health
Instagram improved self-esteem in all age groups
